problem: A production/runtime commercial-loop migration could be functionally correct while the canonical delivery gate remained nonterminal because repository closure evidence was absent.
root_cause: The material R4 Supabase change was committed without the three repository closure surfaces required by the Integration Bundle: brain learning, development ledger evidence, and human-readable change documentation.
prevention: Every material Supabase/brain-runtime delivery must include repository closure evidence in the same candidate before terminal merge evaluation.
Exact-HEAD evaluation is authoritative; successful sibling workflows never override an incomplete Integration Bundle.
Writer lease metadata must be rebound to the final exact HEAD after closure artifacts are added.
A downstream test failure caused by preflight closure is not retried blindly; the missing closure evidence is added first.
Merge and production readback remain blocked until the complete exact-HEAD check-run set is terminally acceptable.
